# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 15 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 7 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Size — 16 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #1d2024);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #1d2024 | Cards, reader page, editor, inputs, buttons. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #eceef2 | #111316 | Inline code, empty-column well, editor gutter. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-hover` | #eef0f3 | #262a2f |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #15181d);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #e7e9ec);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #15181d;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #15181d | #e7e9ec | Primary text on bg, surface, surface-hover, surface-sunken. |
| `--ink-muted` | #4d5562 | #a7aeb9 | Card summaries, path, counts, status bar text. At least 6.4:1 on all surfaces. |
| `--ink-faint` | #626a78 | #8c939e | Placeholders, separators, empty-state text. At least 4.5:1 on all surfaces; never smaller than 11px. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #f4f5f7);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #15171a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f4f5f7;
```

### Tokens (15)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #f4f5f7 | #15171a | App ground: board, header, status bar. |
| `--line` | #cfd4db | #353a42 | Card borders, dividers, header and status bar rules. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control. |
| `--line-strong` | #7c8491 | #737c89 | Every control edge: input, button, checkbox, kbd. 3.2:1 or better on every surface in both themes. |
| `--accent` | #2b54c4 | #86a4ff | Selection, primary button fill, links, focus ring. |
| `--focus` | #2b54c4 | #86a4ff | 2px keyboard focus ring on every focusable element. |
| `--focus-halo` | rgba(43,84,196,0.20) | rgba(134,164,255,0.26) | Soft 3px glow around a focused text field, textarea, composer or editor, outside its single focus-coloured border. Never a second ring. |
| `--status-todo` | #5e6878 | #a4adba | Todo column marker and label. Always shown with the word Todo. |
| `--status-ready` | #0f6e78 | #4fc4cf | Ready column marker: refined issues queued for an agent to take. |
| `--status-doing` | #a04f00 | #eda24a | Doing column marker; unsaved-changes pill in the editor. |
| `--status-done` | #1d7347 | #5fc98e | Done column marker; Saved pill; Pass verdict in a review. |
| `--review` | #7a3fd1 | #b79cff | Violet. The AI review button and the Challenge verdict. Reserved: nothing else uses this hue. Kept clearly apart from the blue accent and from danger red. |
| `--review-soft` | #f1ebfc | #2a2245 | Review panel header fill and the pending-review card flag. |
| `--danger` | #b42318 | #ff8a7a | Write failures, conflicting file on disk, Block verdict. |
| `--danger-soft` | #fdecea | #3d1a17 | Delete drop zone when a card is over it. danger text reads 5.7:1 on it. |
| `--scrim` | rgba(21,24,29,0.32) | rgba(0,0,0,0.55) | Dims the board behind a modal confirmation. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 15px/20px "Inter", -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-ui-title);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-title` | `.ui-title`, `--text-ui-title` | 15px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Project name in the header; reader h2. |
| `ui-body` | `.ui-body`, `--text-ui-body` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI text, inputs, card titles (at 500). |
| `ui-strong` | `.ui-strong`, `--text-ui-strong` | 13px / 18px | 500 | `sans` | Card title, current crumb, button labels at 12px. |
| `ui-small` | `.ui-small`, `--text-ui-small` | 12px / 17px | 400 | `sans` | Card summary, review findings. |
| `ui-label` | `.ui-label`, `--text-ui-label` | 11px / 14px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 600 | `sans` | Column titles, uppercase only. |
| `read-h1` | `.read-h1`, `--text-read-h1` | 20px / 26px | 600 | `sans` | Issue title in the reader. |
| `read-body` | `.read-body`, `--text-read-body` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Rendered markdown paragraphs and lists, max 68ch. |
| `edit-body` | `.edit-body`, `--text-edit-body` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | The plain-text editor. |
| `meta` | `.meta`, `--text-meta` | 11px / 14px | 500 | `mono` | Counts, file names, kbd hints, status bar. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Inter", -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 2px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 2px | Icon to label nudges, kbd padding. |
| `--space-2` | 4px | Gap inside a card between title and summary. |
| `--space-3` | 8px | Gap between cards and between header controls. |
| `--space-4` | 12px | Card horizontal padding, review row padding. |
| `--space-5` | 16px | Window gutter, column gap. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Reader page vertical padding. |
| `--space-7` | 32px | Reader page horizontal padding. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-popover: 0 4px 16px rgba(21,24,29,0.12) in the light theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-popover), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-popover` | 0 4px 16px rgba(21,24,29,0.12) · dark: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | Review panel, menus and a dragged card. Cards stay flat; modals use shadow-modal. |
| `--shadow-modal` | 0 12px 40px rgba(21,24,29,0.18) · dark: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) | Modals only (S to XL), above the scrim. Stronger than shadow-popover because a modal floats over everything. |

## Size

Fixed control heights, in points. Compact but at least 22pt to stay clickable on a trackpad.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--control-h: 24px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--control-h), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (16)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--control-h` | 24px | Buttons, filter input, checkbox row. |
| `--bar-h` | 40px | Header bar. |
| `--statusbar-h` | 24px | Bottom status bar. |
| `--column-min` | 280px | Narrowest column before the board scrolls horizontally. |
| `--column-max` | 420px | Widest column; extra width stays empty on the right. |
| `--reader-max` | 720px | Reader and editor page width. |
| `--scroll-thumb` | 4px | Scrollbar thumb width at rest and while scrolling. Overlay: takes no layout width. |
| `--scroll-thumb-hover` | 8px | Scrollbar thumb width under the pointer and while dragging. |
| `--scroll-hit` | 12px | Scrollbar pointer target along the pane's edge, wider than the thumb so a trackpad finds it. |
| `--scroll-thumb-min` | 24px | Shortest thumb on a very long page, the same as control-h. |
| `--modal-s` | 360px | Modal S: one question, one action (ConfirmDialog). |
| `--modal-m` | 480px | Modal M: forms and settings (Settings, GroupsDialog). |
| `--modal-l` | 760px | Modal L: one document, a 720pt sheet with 20pt each side. |
| `--modal-xl` | 1200px | Modal XL maximum width; otherwise the window minus modal-inset each side (NewIssueModal, RefinePanel). |
| `--modal-xl-h` | 900px | Modal XL maximum height; XL is always this tall or the window minus the inset, so nothing jumps while content streams in. |
| `--modal-inset` | 32px | Gap kept between the window edge and a modal; 16 under 720pt of window width. |
